adopted_capacity_decision.reason: For source short distances, loaded flight plus unloading plus empty return may finish within 1 min. On integer-minute departures both hub movements then occupy the same fixed window; quota 1 gives those individual tasks no feasible option and prevents an all-service incumbent. Quota 2 supports the full-cycle input design without changing source selection.
